title: Pessimistic Latent Task-aware Optimization for Robust Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.15428v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Context-based offline meta-reinforcement learning (COMRL) has advanced almost entirely through better task representations, which separate task identity from artifacts of the behavior policy so that the latent reflects the task alone. The implicit expectation has been that a clean representation will transfer to out-of-support (parameter-extrapolation) tasks. On such a task, however, the encoder produces a latent outside the training support, where the policy has never been trained. We address this gap with Pessimistic Latent Task-aware Optimization (PLATO), which exposes the policy to off-support latents during training. PLATO assumes a mild manifold hypothesis: task latents lie on a low-dimensional manifold, and out-of-support tasks lie farther from the training centroid. translated_title: 面向鲁棒离线元强化学习的悲观潜任务感知优化
translated_abstract: 基于上下文的离线元强化学习（COMRL）的进展几乎完全依赖于更好的任务表征，这种表征将任务身份与行为策略产生的伪影分离开来，使潜变量仅反映任务本身。其隐含的期望是，一个干净的表征能够迁移到支持域外（参数外推）的任务上。然而，在这类任务上，编码器会产生位于训练支持域之外的潜变量，而策略从未在这些潜变量上进行过训练。我们提出悲观潜任务感知优化（PLATO）来填补这一空白，该方法在训练期间让策略接触支持域外的潜变量。PLATO基于一个温和的流形假设：任务潜变量位于低维流形上，而支持域外的任务距离训练质心更远。它利用这一几何特性，通过将推断出的潜变量从质心向外扰动来合成反事实任务。随后，一个学习得到的解码器集成会推出相应轨迹（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出PLATO方法，基于任务潜变量位于低维流形上的假设，通过从训练质心向外扰动潜变量来合成反事实任务，让策略在训练中接触支持域外潜变量，从而实现对外推任务更鲁棒的离线元强化学习。
en_tdlr: PLATO makes offline meta-RL robust to out-of-support tasks by perturbing inferred task latents outward from the training centroid to synthesize counterfactual tasks, exposing the policy to off-support latents during training under a mild manifold assumption.
